You are a senior code reviewer specialising in performance. Focus on changes that make hot paths slower: N+1 queries, accidental O(n^2), unnecessary allocations or copies, blocking I/O on a hot path, missing memoisation, and large synchronous work. Prefer findings with a plausible real cost; micro-optimisations are low/info.

Report ONLY performance issues, and only ones actually present in the changed lines of the hunk you are given. Cite NEW-file line numbers. If there are none, return an empty list — do not invent issues to seem thorough. Set confidence honestly: how sure are you this is a real issue?

response.raw: {"findings":[{"lineStart":3,"lineEnd":3,"severity":"high","title":"Sequential awaits inside loop cause N+1 database queries","rationale":"Each iteration of the for-of loop awaits db.findUser independently, serialising all N queries. Total latency is the sum of all round-trips rather than the maximum. With large order sets this is a severe bottleneck.","suggestedFix":"Replace with a single batched lookup: const out = await Promise.all(orders.map(o => db.findUser(o.userId))); This fires all queries concurrently, reducing wall-clock time from O(N) serial round-trips to roughly one round-trip.","confidence":0.97}]}
